info.name: Express POD callbacks
info.description: One Express inbound URL: POST {{express_base_url}}/api/v1/express/callback. Events differ. express_base_url defaults to https://api.tukaatuexpress.com. For local Express, set express_base_url to the express_base_url_local value http://localhost:8081. marketplace_base_url defaults to https://api.tukaatu.com; FCA is https://api.fca.com.np. Key, secret, and callback secret variables are empty placeholders.

variable.description: Live Express. For local, set this to http://localhost:8081 (see express_base_url_local).
Optional local Express base. Copy onto express_base_url when calling a local stack. Requests use express_base_url.
TUKAATU_CALLBACK_SECRET. Leave empty in the shared file. Pre-request script signs the raw body when this is set.
X-Tukaatu-Signature hex. Filled by the pre-request script when callback_secret is set.
Express pod_payment_sessions.payment_session_id for a delivery assignment. Required to find the session.

header.description: Required for the delivery POD branch. Body field event is the fallback.
HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body using TUKAATU_CALLBACK_SECRET. Required when that secret (or the legacy Store Manager payment secret) is configured.

request.description:
Inbound callback. Express route POST /api/v1/express/callback -> StoreManagerPaymentWebhookController::handle, then TukaatuPodPaymentService::handleDeliveryPodCallback for pod_payment.ready|paid|failed.

Lookup: payment_session_id, else session_id (also data.payment_session_id / data.session_id). The row must have delivery_assignment_id. merchant_txn_id alone does not find the session (404).

Headers the POD path checks:
- X-Tukaatu-Event: event name (or JSON field event).
- X-Tukaatu-Signature: required when TUKAATU_CALLBACK_SECRET or the legacy Store Manager payment secret is set. HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw JSON body. If X-Tukaatu-Timestamp is also sent (unix seconds), the signature is HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + "." + raw body, and the timestamp must be within 300 seconds. Leave timestamp unset to sign the body only. Local/testing with no secret configured accepts an empty signature.
- X-Tukaatu-Event-ID is optional idempotency, not required.

Set collection variable callback_secret to fill X-Tukaatu-Signature in the pre-request script. Otherwise paste the hex into callback_signature. Do not put real secrets in this file.

amount is accepted in the sample body but this handler does not change the session amount.

This request: applyReady. Sets status ready (unless already paid), merchant_txn_id when present, checkout_url from payment_url, qr_payload from qr_string when non-empty. qr_string null is valid. transaction_id and message are not applied on ready. amount is not applied.

request.description:
Documentation only. This is the outbound call Express makes from RequestTukaatuPodPaymentJob, not an Express inbound route.

POST {{marketplace_base_url}}/api/v1/gateway/payments/pod-qr
marketplace_base_url default https://api.tukaatu.com. FCA is https://api.fca.com.np (change the variable; do not add a second live host here).

Headers: X-Tukaatu-Key and X-Tukaatu-Secret. No signature header on this request.

Body matches the job: external_store_id, merchant_order_id, external_order_id, tracking_number, amount (number), session_id, payment_session_id, callback_url. callback_url is always {{express_base_url}}/api/v1/express/callback. session_id and payment_session_id are the same Express payment_session_id. The marketplace may ignore unknown fields.

Expected success shape from the live pod-qr API: success true, data.payment_url, data.merchant_txn_id, data.qr_string (often null), data.params, data.expires_at, data.amount. Express then marks the session ready when success is true and payment_url is present.
